name: magenda
description: MCP server that generates a deterministic, pixel-identical daily agenda PDF from a compiled template -- no LibreOffice required.
long_description: Magenda generates a daily agenda PDF laid out exactly like a fixed template. Tools only inject plain text into known slots or clone pre-formatted pages -- there is no AI-generated layout. Rendering is pure Python (no external app, no LibreOffice) against a template compiled once ahead of time; no extra install step needed.
